summary: Unknown adult male collided with a 13-year-old skier near the bottom of the Grubstake Trail in Bachelor Gulch, Beaver Creek, around 2 p.m. on Sunday, January 30, 2022, and left the scene; the teen suffered several injuries including a broken clavicle. The Eagle County Sheriff's Office issued a press release seeking information on the hit-and-run suspect (described as a white male in his 60s).
location: Beaver Creek Ski Resort, Bachelor Gulch, bottom of Grubstake Trail
notes: Source: Eagle County Sheriff's Office press release republished by Real Vail, published 2022-02-03. In-bounds ski-area injury included per the run-977 ski-area precedent (ids 3282/3469); no ski patrol or SAR team named in the source. Inserted run 1015 (Vail Daily chunk).
